params.caption: 🕹️ The original Xbox turns 25 today Microsoft's first console launched in North America 25 years ago, running on an Intel Pentium III CPU and an Nvidia GPU. Tom's Hardware notes it did surprisingly well in an era dominated by the PS2, and it kicked off the Xbox brand that is still going today. 🕒 Nov 15, 2026 · 14:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware 👥 @Xbox 🎂 React if you owned one · 💬 What was your first Xbox game? #Xbox #Microsoft #RetroGaming #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
